title: CNN eye-state classifier inference wrapper
description: Implement detection/model_runner.py to load and run inference with trained binary eye-state CNN models (.keras, .h5, or mock fallback) returning p_closed probabilities and latency metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads Keras/TFLite model from specified path under models/ or falls back to a deterministic mock predictor when model is missing
Performs batch inference on normalized eye crops and returns probability p_closed in [0.0, 1.0]
Measures and reports per-inference latency in milliseconds
Unit tests verify inference output formats, probabilities bounds, and mock fallback behavior

steps.details: Create detection/model_runner.py with ModelRunner supporting load_model(model_path) and predict_batch(crops).

steps.description: Implement robust model loader with mock fallback
steps.details: If model file exists, load with tf.keras.models.load_model; if not found or in test mode, initialize a lightweight mock model returning predictable probabilities.
Measure inference execution time using time.perf_counter() and expose average latency.
Create tests/test_model_runner.py testing prediction outputs on dummy numpy arrays (batch_size, 96, 96, 3).

technicalNotes: Support CPU-only inference first without requiring GPU acceleration.
Ensure predictor is thread-safe for background worker invocation.
